search_patents.description: Search Chinese patents (country:CN) via Google Patents and extract top results (title, patent number, assignee, dates, abstract).

query.description: Search query string (Chinese or English keywords).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to extract (1-100, default 10).

returns.description: Array of {title, number, country, inventors, assignee, dates, abstract, url, pdfUrl} objects (country is always CN).
